question: Can one athlete, trained alone, stand for 3 s at the facing 0.5 m spawn and land a glove strike? (the capability every league v0.0.11-v0.0.14 lacked)
why_not_a_league: v0.0.14 got 0/840 valid games; leagues on the current motor are guaranteed stage-1 failures (cycle 0018 recommendation)
classification: single-athlete motor diagnostic in the shared two-person world; not boxing, not self-play, not an Elo claim
env: grokbot.scenarios.RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000); unchanged jekko env; runs to the horizon (does not stop at the first fall)
opponent: frozen v0.0.11 gen4 posture policy (deterministic) in corner B
baseline_measurement_before_training: the same gate on gen4 posture (no punch) with the same seeds

gate.stance_pass: candidate stands (no persistent non-foot floor support) for the full 3000 ticks
gate.reach_pass: candidate lands >= 1 strike tick (approach and referee active speed >= 0.5 m/s on a strike target)

criteria.primary_motor_gate: stance_pass_rate >= 0.50 AND reach_pass_rate >= 0.50 over the 24 gate trials
criteria.secondary: paired stand-time gain vs gen4 baseline on the same 24 seeds, one-sided 95% lower bound (Hoeffding on gains clipped to [-3, 3] s) reported
criteria.level_up: v0.0.15 is a level-up (tagged) iff the primary motor gate passes

pre_declared_readings: stance fails: linear posture control on 10 regions cannot hold the native keyframe; next lever is jekko's pretrained bridge or a richer (group-level / recurrent) controller
stance passes, reach fails: balance is solvable; the reach primitive must be retargeted (elbow extension, height) before any league
both pass: preregister a v0.0.16 league with the stage-1 valid-game floor
